key_insight: AGDN improves TSP solving by combining node similarity and distance into an anisotropic diffusion process that better preserves useful graph structure than standard sparsification.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical GNN-based optimization tool for routing and logistics problems where both solution quality and inference efficiency matter.
method: Build a MixScore transition matrix that blends node similarity with pairwise distance.
Apply anisotropic graph diffusion to exchange information efficiently over multiple hops.
Avoid overly aggressive sparsification that can drop nodes needed in the optimal tour.
evidence_signal: Experiments on diverse TSP sizes and node distributions show AGDN consistently outperforms prior methods while remaining computationally competitive and generalizing beyond training settings.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how well the MixScore matrix and diffusion hyperparameters are tuned for different graph sizes and distributions.
paper_title: AGDN: Learning to Solve Traveling Salesman Problem with Anisotropic Graph Diffusion Network
